reviews.review_msg: Would not recommend. The lectures were hard to follow and the exams were way too difficult compared to what we were taught. I spent a lot of time studying but still felt completely unprepared for the tests.

Not a good professor. The exams were extremely difficult and felt much harder than what was covered in class. The teaching was unclear and did not prepare students well for the tests. Overall, a very frustrating experience.

It's near impossible to keep up in lecture. It is quite hard to understand him due to the language barrier and he uses ALOT of technical terms. Lots of 'Uhms' and 'uhs' while he talks makes it even harder to keep up. 

You'll have to learn everything on your own.
